stories.title: Raptors fall to Knicks for fifth straight loss
stories.summary: Jalen Brunson drilled a three-pointer with 1:25 left to play as the New York Knicks escaped with a 111-102 win over the Toronto Raptors on Tuesday for the second game in a row.

stories.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford touts stronger ties with Quebec in Montreal speech
stories.summary: The premier used the appearance to highlight the combined economic strength of Ontario and Quebec, describing the two provinces as Canada's economic drivers.

stories.title: Ford government caps hearings on ‘red tape’ bill amid environmental outcry
stories.summary: First Nations leaders, environmentalists, and legal advocates are urging the government to scrap elements of Bill 140, warning the legislation would gut environmental safeguards.

stories.title: Raptors forward Leonard out at least another week
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors will be without forward Kawhi Leonard for at least another week as he deals with swelling in his left knee.

stories.title: Cadet captain paralyzed from waist down after Hamilton attack
stories.summary: Police have said the Nov. 8 attack stemmed from a confrontation over the harassment of young cadets selling Remembrance Day poppies.

stories.title: National Congress of American Indians calls on Trump to reverse Lake Ontario change
stories.summary: The National Congress of American Indians is calling on U.S. President Donald Trump to walk back his August executive order renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America.

stories.title: Ontario secondary teachers vote 96% in favour of strike mandate
stories.summary: The OSSTF says teachers have been pushed to the brink in their profession as a result of Ford government under-funding education.

stories.title: Ford government moves to shield itself from lawsuits related to OSAP fraud probe
stories.summary: Nolan Quinn, Ontario’s minister of colleges and universities sidestepped questions in the legislature Tuesday about the government looking to grant itself legal immunity.

stories.title: 12 arrested, 231 charges laid after Ontario auto theft ring dismantled
stories.summary: Police claim a criminal network was responsible for coordinating thefts, movements and exports of stolen vehicles across the Greater Toronto Area.

stories.title: Trillium College students disappointed at selective return to classes
stories.summary: Students at one career college are decrying its approach to the OSAP pause, with the school allowing only those who can pay without the financial aid to continue learning.
